column2: Slope Base Deep Profiler Mooring: During this bounce dive on the Deep Profiler Mooring (DP01A-2015), cable SBVMW4 from LV01A was connected to the docking station. The beacons from the base and top of the mooring were recovered and four Niskins bottles were tripped at 2600, 2700, 2800 meters, and near dock. ROPOS followed the mooring cable upward with the CTD running for follow-on verification. Immediately after connection of the cable, the mooring was powered up. Communication with APL onshore showed that the docking station and Deep Profiler were communicating, no ground faults were detected. Two of the "weird fish" (Genioliparis ferox) were also observed and imaged.

column3: Biology:  As a subjective observation, salps seem to be more numerous at this site than at Axial or Hydrate.  Difficult to capture on camera.
